glosses: thesis, essay, dissertation (lengthy essay written to establish the validity of a theory, especially one submitted in order to complete the requirements for a degree)
thesis (the initial stage of reasoning where a formal statement of a point is developed, followed by the antithesis and the synthesis)

examples.text: Avez-vous décidé de votre sujet de thèse ?
examples.en: Have you decided on the subject of your thesis?
I have a thesis to write.

examples.text: As-tu fini de rédiger ta thèse ?
examples.en: Have you finished writing your thesis?

examples.text: Avez-vous déjà choisi votre sujet de thèse ?
examples.en: Have you already decided on your thesis topic?
